items.title: Meta Launches Simple-To-Use Muse Personal AI Agent
items.summary: Meta Platforms on Tuesday launched a personal AI agent app that it said will be simple to use and can help people accomplish real-world tasks.  Meta stock closed regular-session trading slightly lower.  The so-called Muse agent fits with a broader effort from Meta Chief Executive Mark Zuckerberg to offer "personal superintelligence."

items.title: Meta stock wavers as Zuckerberg unveils ‘Muse’ autonomous AI assistant
items.summary: Investing.com -- Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) shares saw a choppy trading session—initially popping 1% before sliding into the red—following the reveal of Muse, a proactive personal AI agent built to execute digital chores on your behalf. Powered by Meta’s new real-world task model, Muse Spark, the agent goes far beyond standard chatbots. items.title: Will Direct TPU Sales Re-Rate Google Stock?
items.summary: Quietly, a merchant silicon business is emerging inside the world's largest advertising platform. The company has now started delivering its custom TPU systems directly into customer data centers. This marks a fundamental expansion of the business model, moving from selling services to selling the core hardware that powers the AI transition.
